_comment: Doc 1 §2.4 resolveEnding() output maps here. Each ending is a 3D set (data/rooms.json `room`) and the camera move played in it (`shot`), then a dead-still `holdSeconds` before the card (Doc 2: a 4 second hold with no motion whatsoever). Doc 1 §6.4 for card text (textKey resolved via text.js against /text/endings.json). C4 is deliberately broken only on these cards -- 'you' appears exactly once per card.

flagOverlays.note: Doc 1 §2.5: if NEVER_SAT there is no chair for him at all in the boardroom pull-back. The boardroom is a live set now (rooms.json SE_ASSIM, prop named `emptychair`), so this becomes a stage-side hide of that prop rather than a video patch; not wired yet.

RETAINED._note: Added post-launch (Doc 1 §9.1). The same boardroom as ASSIMILATION, a shorter pull-back that keeps the package in frame.
